name: Maria Prokofieva

tagline: AI for the human side of money.

spineThird: Builds AI that reads the human behaviour behind financial numbers, in how people manage, audit, invest and spend money, and publishes the evidence that it works.
bio: Maria Prokofieva is an Associate Professor and Fellow of CPA Australia, native in both finance and AI. Money is managed by people — executives who control it, auditors contracted to check it, investors and consumers spending their own — and she builds machine-learning and language-model systems that read the human behaviour behind the numbers. Her work spans financial reporting and audit, behavioural finance and agentic commerce, and her models are released with open code, data and evaluation results, so their quality and impact can be tracked rather than taken on trust. She teaches advanced AI to specialist and non-specialist audiences without simplifying it away.
